title: isTrustedSender trusts a caller-supplied domain independently of the email, tolerates multi-@ strings, and does no trimming or validation
evidence: isTrustedSender('evil@x.com@ashoka.edu.in', undefined, cfg) is true (domain taken after the LAST @); isTrustedSender('evil@x.com', 'ashoka.edu.in', cfg) is true because the explicit domain argument is never checked against the email's own domain. Safe today only because gws-gmail derives senderDomain from the same string. Reproduced in join-rules.test.ts 'documented deliberate divergence'. Not edited per unit limits.
fix_direction: When the switch-over unit moves the scheduler to evaluateJoinRules, drop the separate domain argument and derive the domain from the validated email; otherwise reject domain/email mismatches in isTrustedSender.
